verdict.rationale: Asking whether a robotics simulation platform can turn a natural-language task into a plan and execute it is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo offering natural-language input, LLM task planning or autonomous execution. The documented features are physics, sensors, plugins, CLI tools, a GUI, transport messaging and ROS integration, which are building blocks at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can express a robot task in natural language and have the platform plan and execute it
